name: MD-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 10-point Democratic lean plus favorable national environment
Incumbent Johnny Olszewski running with a large fundraising edge ($1.0M raised vs. $20K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~94%
Republican challenger is minimally funded with no outside support
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Olszewski: a D+10 district, incumbency, a favorable environment, and a roughly 50-to-1 fundraising advantage over Dave Wallace. Markets price the race at about 94% Democratic, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Olszewski would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Maryland's 2nd District leans Democratic by about 10 points, and first-term incumbent Johnny Olszewski is running for reelection with a commanding financial position. He has raised over $1 million and holds more than $600,000 on hand, while Republican Dave Wallace has raised about $20,000 with minimal cash remaining and no outside support on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put the Democratic win probability around 94%. With the incumbent, the district lean, and the money gap all pointing the same direction, the seat is rated Safe Democratic.
